The '''Surgical Nursing Services''' was a medical organization within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One of their primary functions was to make sure Republic [[Nurse/Legends|nurses]] are up to date on their medical knowledge, requiring them to under go training courses like the [[Continuing Medical Education]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
